page.title: Query
page.subtitle: Run SQL, build a query visually, or upload a CSV/Excel file. Results load into the grid and feed the Analyze tab for charts and scripts.

tooltips.likeValue: Use % as a wildcard — e.g. %abc% matches any value containing 'abc'.
tooltips.inValue: Separate multiple values with ';' — e.g. A; B.
tooltips.noValueNeeded: No value needed for this operator

helpDialog.operatorsSubtitle: Reference for the operator dropdowns in the criteria fields
helpDialog.autocompleteSubtitle: Query faster in the SQL and Python editors

shortcuts.type: Suggestions appear automatically while you type.
shortcuts.manual: Open the suggestion list manually at the cursor.
shortcuts.mouse: Accept a suggestion with the mouse.

helpDialog.info: While the list is open, Enter or Tab accepts the highlighted suggestion — press Esc first if you want a newline. The SQL editor suggests SQL keywords; the Python editor also suggests builtins and snippets.

operatorGuide.like: Pattern match. You type the % wildcards yourself — %abc% contains, abc% starts with, %abc ends with.
operatorGuide.in: Value must / must not be in a list. Separate values with ;
operatorGuide.isNull: Value is empty / not empty (no value input needed).
operatorGuide.between: Value within an inclusive range — fill the from and to fields.
operatorGuide.compare: Greater than, greater or equal, less than, less or equal.

validation.dateRangeOrder: The date range start must not be after the end.

builder.title: Query Builder
builder.noFilters: No filters — all rows will be returned.
builder.selectTableForColumns: Select a table to see its columns.
builder.noDateColumns: No date/time columns detected in this table.
builder.calculatedHelp: Append a database-evaluated expression to the result, e.g. name "Delta" and expression "AFTER - BEFORE". The expression becomes expr AS name in the SELECT list.
builder.examplesHint: Tap an example to fill the last calculated expression.
builder.noCalculated: No calculated columns — expressions are appended as-is to the SELECT list.
builder.generatedSqlPlaceholder: Generated SQL appears here as you define your criteria…

sqlEditor.loadingColumnsStar: Loading columns… (the base SQL selects all columns of the primary table)
sqlEditor.noAdditionalColumns: No additional columns available — the base SQL selects no explicit columns.
sqlEditor.noSqlYet: No SQL yet — expand to write a query.
sqlEditor.formatTooltip: Pretty-print the SQL for the selected connection's dialect
sqlEditor.recentRunsTooltip: Show your recent SQL runs — click Run or Load to reuse them
sqlEditor.saveSqlTooltip: Save the current query as a custom query

results.title: Data
results.pasteTooltip: Paste rows from the clipboard — clears the current rows and replaces the table contents (creates a new table when no results are loaded yet)
results.tableFeaturesTooltip: See everything this table can do
results.editGridTooltip: Edit this grid — AI transform, column data types and calculated columns
results.saveDataTooltip: Save this grid as a snapshot in the Dashboard warehouse
results.pipelineTransform: Converting to a wide table with Python…
results.readingWorkbook: Reading workbook… this can take a while for large files

history.empty: No recent runs yet. Run a query to record it here.

saveDialog.title: Save as pre-defined
saveDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: What this query is for — shown on the pre-defined card.
saveDialog.promptsHelp: Ask for a value when this saved query is run. Each prompt becomes a filter on the chosen column.
saveDialog.label: Label
saveDialog.noPrompts: No prompts — the saved query runs with its current filters.

reminders.dateCriteriaBody_one: The date field below must be specified before the query runs — otherwise it would search the full date range.
reminders.dateCriteriaBody_other: The date fields below must be specified before the query runs — otherwise it would search the full date range.
reminders.filterRequiredBody: Specify at least one parameter before running — otherwise the query would search the entire table.

warehouseDialog.title: Save to warehouse
warehouseDialog.body: Copies the current grid ({{size}}) into the local SQLite warehouse shown in the Dashboard tab.

messages.warehouseSaved_other: Saved "{{name}}" ({{count}} rows) — manage it in the Dashboard tab
messages.transformed_one: Transformed {{count}} row into a wide table.
messages.transformed_other: Transformed {{count}} rows into a wide table.
messages.gridReverted: Grid reverted to the previous state.

messages.failLoadGenealogy: Failed to load the FabLIMS lot genealogy.

messages.nothingToExport: Nothing to export — run a query first.
